User.title: User
User.description: User profile metadata stored upon Google sign-in

uid.description: The unique Firebase Authentication user ID

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was first created in Firestore

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp when the user most recently signed in

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document containing only the user's UID, display name, email, photo URL, createdAt, and lastLoginAt
